en-GB.title: Ban-go: Number Plate Check
en-GB.subtitle: MOT, Tax & Car History Check
en-GB.description:
🚗 Know any car instantly — just from its number plate.

Spotted a car and want to know more? Ban-go turns any UK number plate into a full vehicle report in seconds — straight from official DVLA and DVSA records. No sign-up, no subscription, no fuss.

── WHAT YOU GET ──────────────────────────
✓ Make, model, year & registered colour
✓ Full MOT history with mileage timeline
✓ Recurring MOT failure points
✓ Fuel type, engine size & CO₂ emissions
✓ Estimated annual running costs & tax band
✓ Insurance group estimate
✓ Euro NCAP safety rating
✓ Used cars for sale near you

── GREAT FOR ─────────────────────────────
• Checking a used car before you buy it
• Settling "what car is that?" debates on the spot
• Spotting clocked mileage or a patchy MOT record
• Verifying a car matches the seller's advert
• Working out running costs before you commit

── HOW IT WORKS ──────────────────────────
1. Type in the number plate — or scan it with your camera
2. Get a full vehicle report, instantly
3. Tap through to used listings near you

── OFFICIAL DATA ─────────────────────────
UK data comes directly from the DVSA (official MOT records) and DVLA, so your MOT history, mileage and vehicle details are accurate and up to date.

Travelling in the US? Ban-go also decodes US plates with NHTSA safety ratings, EPA fuel economy and active recalls.

Ban-go is the fastest way to check any car on the road. Whether you're a used-car buyer, a car enthusiast, or just curious about the car parked outside — Ban-go has the answer.
en-GB.promoText: Now with cleaner reports & faster plate scans. Decode any UK plate — MOT history, mileage, running costs, safety & used cars near you. Official DVLA & DVSA data.

en-US.title: Ban-go: License Plate Lookup
en-US.subtitle: VIN, Recalls & Vehicle Report
en-US.description:
🚗 Know any car instantly — just from its license plate.

Saw a car and want to know more? Ban-go turns any US or UK license plate into a full vehicle report in seconds. No sign-up, no subscription, no fuss.

── WHAT YOU GET ──────────────────────────
✓ Make, model, year & color
✓ NHTSA overall safety rating
✓ Active safety recalls (NHTSA)
✓ EPA fuel economy — city & highway MPG
✓ Fuel type & engine details
✓ Estimated annual running costs
✓ Used cars for sale near you
✓ UK plates: full MOT history & mileage timeline

── GREAT FOR ─────────────────────────────
• Checking a used car before you buy it
• Settling "what car is that?" debates on the spot
• Seeing whether a car has open recalls
• Verifying a car matches the seller's listing
• Researching running costs before you commit

── HOW IT WORKS ──────────────────────────
1. Enter the license plate — or scan it with your camera
2. Pick your country (US or UK)
3. Get a full vehicle report, instantly

── OFFICIAL DATA ─────────────────────────
US data comes from the NHTSA (safety ratings and recalls) and the EPA (fuel economy estimates). UK data comes directly from the DVSA and DVLA (official MOT records).

Ban-go is the fastest way to look up any car on the road. Whether you're a used-car buyer, a car enthusiast, or just curious about the car parked outside — Ban-go has the answer.
